title: The lesson is the same. The learner isn't.
script: Imagine understanding a lesson, but struggling to access the explanation. Lumi is an Arabic and English learning companion designed around children who need a different approach.

title: Reading should not block learning.
script: A review covering over thirty thousand Arab primary-school children estimated dyslexia prevalence at eleven percent. Needs differ, but children need accessible explanations, and adults need visibility beyond the final answer.

title: One companion. Three ways to learn.
script: Lumi offers three adult-selected modes: voice-first support for dyslexia, smaller steps for learning difficulties, and calm, predictable interactions for autism. Adults choose the language and review learning observations. This is educational support, not diagnosis.

title: Start in Jordan. Expand with evidence.
script: Jordan and Saudi Arabia have 4.56 million primary pupils. Applying the research estimate and proposed school price gives a thirty-million-dollar scenario, not a forecast. We start with supervised Jordanian pilots.

title: A focused position in an active market.
script: Alternatives already exist: Lexsee supports reading, Faheem connects families with tutors, and Khanmigo offers broad AI tutoring. Lumi focuses on bilingual, mode-specific support with adult oversight.

title: Schools first. Families alongside.
script: We propose five dollars per student monthly for schools, billed annually, and ten dollars for families. Pilots must validate pricing, repeat use, and voice costs.

title: Early interest. A measurable route to adoption.
script: Our team reports thirty-seven waitlist signups and ten thousand Instagram views, plus specialist feedback and one school willing to trial. Our route is Instagram demonstrations, supervised pilots, then paid conversion.

title: Help us turn interest into evidence.
script: We are seeking pilot schools and specialist partners to measure usefulness and learning support. Together, we can test what works before expanding. Help Lumi make room for every mind.
